Tagcast 0.41.1 makes signing in easier: new users can connect directly without
creating an iBroadcast app or entering a client ID. The change is included in all
standalone downloads for macOS, Windows and Linux.

## Direct sign-in

- Tagcast includes its public OAuth client ID. Click **Connect iBroadcast**, then
  **Sign in with a code** and approve access on the iBroadcast website. Your
  password stays on iBroadcast; no client secret is required or bundled.
- Existing saved client IDs, environment overrides and their connections are
  preserved. Nothing is migrated automatically. To switch an older saved
  registration, first **Disconnect**, then choose **Use Tagcast sign-in** and
  sign in again. Existing custom configurations retain browser-redirect sign-in.
- Optional queue synchronisation uses code sign-in to request its additional
  permissions with the shared registration. During reauthorization, Tagcast waits
  for the new approval even if the previous session is still connected.
- The README includes the simplified instructions and a new sign-in screenshot.

iBroadcast Support confirmed that Tagcast may distribute its public client ID
while its Apps-page review is pending. This is not a claim of listing or endorsement.

## Standalone downloads and updating

- **macOS Apple Silicon:** `tagcast-0.41.1-macos-arm64.zip`.
- **macOS Intel:** `tagcast-0.41.1-macos-x64.zip`.
- **Windows x64:** `tagcast-0.41.1-windows-x64.zip`.
- **Linux x64:** `tagcast-0.41.1-linux-x64.tar.gz`.

Each archive includes Python, dependencies, the desktop launcher, a separate CLI,
license notices and a companion SHA-256 checksum.

**Stop the old Tagcast before starting 0.41.1.** Otherwise the new launcher opens
the already-running server. Your settings, tokens and library cache remain in
`~/.tagcast/`, or your configured `TAGCAST_HOME`. Source installations remain
supported with Python 3.11+ or uv.

For Homebrew, stop Tagcast, then run `brew update` and
`brew upgrade --cask cyberdeliaAI/apps/tagcast` after the tap update is available.

See the [README](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast/blob/v0.41.1/README.md)
and [standalone guide](https://github.com/cyberdeliaAI/tagcast/blob/v0.41.1/docs/native-builds.md)
for installation details. Your local music files are never changed.
